user.description: Sign in to your karotto server. A long-lived API token named "Home Assistant" is created for this integration; your password is not stored.

score.name: Score task
score.description: Completes a daily or to-do, uncompletes it, or counts a habit click. Returns the updated task.

task.name: Task
task.description: Alias or ID of the task.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Up completes or counts a positive click, down uncompletes or counts a negative click.

rollover.name: Run rollover first
rollover.description: Run the day rollover before scoring so the completion lands on the right day. Leave on for dailies.

config_entry_id.name: Account

add_task.name: Add task
